title: Google Summer of Code (GSoC)
description: Global open-source contributor program. Best if you can read codebases, contact mentors, and write a clear project proposal.
internship_period: Community bonding May 1-24, 2026; coding starts May 25, 2026
next_window_hint: Usually opens around March each year; begin org research in January-February.

title: Outreachy
description: Paid remote open-source internship focused on people facing underrepresentation, systemic bias, or discrimination in tech.
next_window_hint: December cohort applications are expected from early to mid August; exact dates can shift.

title: LFX Mentorship
description: Linux Foundation mentorships across open-source infrastructure, cloud, security, AI, web, and documentation projects.
internship_period: Fall term typically September 1 to November 30
next_window_hint: Terms usually run Spring, Summer, and Fall; applications are typically open for about 4 weeks.

title: MLH Fellowship
description: Remote 12-week internship alternative for software engineers, with real project work and recurring batches.
internship_period: Runs year-round; Summer 2026 batch listed May 18 to Aug 7, 2026
next_window_hint: Applications are rolling and close a few weeks before each batch starts.

title: CERN openlab Summer Student Programme
description: Nine-week advanced computing summer programme at CERN for students in computing, maths, engineering, or physics.
next_window_hint: Applications commonly open around November for the following summer.

title: Mitacs Globalink Research Internship
description: Research internship in Canada, best for students with strong academics and interest in professor-led research projects.
internship_period: 2026 internships typically happen between May and October
next_window_hint: For the next GRI cycle, start checking Mitacs around August-September.

title: MeitY Digital India Internship Scheme
description: Government of India internship through MeitY/NIC; useful for AI/ML, cybersecurity, digital governance, and public-sector tech exposure.
next_window_hint: Usually a short application window; watch the MeitY internship portal around March-April.
